About this species: Trichodesma africanum is a desert herb that may behave as an annual or short-lived perennial depending on conditions. It grows in dry sandy and stony habitats, open desert plains, and disturbed arid ground. The plant has hairy leaves and stems, a common adaptation that can reduce water loss and protect against intense sunlight. It contributes to the seasonal herb layer of desert vegetation, especially after rainfall.
Geographical distribution: Cape Verde, Sahara to NW. India, Angola to Cape Prov.
